configurations.name: beyond-ed
configurations.comment: Attach-only. The preview harness cannot spawn this project: macOS denies the spawned process read access under ~/Desktop (EPERM on open). Run `pnpm dev` yourself, then attach. To let the harness launch it directly, grant Files and Folders / Full Disk Access to Claude Code, or move the project out of ~/Desktop, then replace this with runtimeExecutable: pnpm, runtimeArgs: [dev], autoPort: true.
